item.title: github: Secret scanning detects Cloudflare service tokens
item.description:
GitHub Secret Scanning now detects Cloudflare service tokens in repositories. The new detector covers the Cloudflare Access service token secret type.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Secret scanning detects secrets in GitHub Actions workflow logs
item.description:
GitHub secret scanning now detects secrets in GitHub Actions workflow logs. The feature is available in public preview and adds workflow logs to the existing scanning coverage for issues, wikis, discussions, and pull requests.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Secret scanning upgrades detectors, adds SpaceX as partner
item.description:
GitHub updated secret scanning by adding SpaceX as a new partner and introducing detection for starlink_public_api_v2_secret. It also upgraded multiple existing detectors, including Alibaba, AWS, Google, OpenVSX, and Pydantic Services.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Security risk assessments include repository protection status
item.description:
GitHub’s code security risk assessment and secret risk assessment now indicate whether findings are in protected or unprotected repositories. This helps organizations see where to extend security coverage.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Public monitoring adds triage, validity, API, and webhooks
item.description:
Public monitoring now includes alert management features for handling leaked secrets at scale. The update adds validity checks, dismissals, timelines, filtering, plus API and webhook support.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Public monitoring now available with data residency
item.description:
GitHub Enterprise Cloud with data residency now supports public monitoring in public preview. This extends secret scanning beyond internal repositories to monitor public content.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Updates to GitHub secret scanning
item.description:
GitHub announced updates to secret scanning, including changes to audit log events and bug fixes. The notice specifically mentions a November 12, 2026 change to the business field in affected secret_scanning_alert.* and secret_scanning_push_protection.bypass audit log events.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Secret scanning blocks Anthropic keys by default, adds Salesforce
item.description:
GitHub secret scanning now detects new secret types for Salesforce, Anthropic, and Cloudsmith. Anthropic keys are blocked with push protection by default.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Secret scanning adds detectors for Lovable, Supabase, and more
item.description:
GitHub Secret Scanning added new detectors for secrets from Lovable Labs, Pydantic Services Inc., and Supabase. A new provider also joined the secret scanning partnership program.

  • Source: GitHub
